name: War crimes remembered
description: Every empire's war crimes are recorded and remembered for generations: bombarding colonies, destroying planets, scorched earth, attacks on refugee convoys and Diet delegates, enslaving conquered peoples and attacks on independent worlds. Each crime costs attitude with every empire (the victim most). When the Interstellar Diet sits (Characters & Victory), members may convene a War Crimes Tribunal against the worst offender: if it passes, sanctions, reparations to the victims and, for the worst records, the trial and removal of the leader.
